thread:
sarah: quick sync — product wants a new runtime dashboard that shows per-tenant p95, model version mix, routing fallback counts, cache hit rate, and cost-by-token. need infra/runtime inputs + a proposal for RBAC/sharing before next week. @eng-sre @security :eyes:

miguel: we can emit tenant-level labels today (tenant_id, model, route_variant). latency histograms already tagged. main gap is cost attribution per-token — runtime can emit token_count and token_cost_estimate metric, but needs mapping to billing units.

jordan: for the dashboard itself, are we building internal-only or will we allow customer-facing shares? that drives what PII/redaction we need.

maya: goal is two modes: internal (full fidelity) and customer (redacted, aggregated). customers should not see other tenants or raw request ids. also need audit trail for any share.

kevin: for redaction: we should avoid sending full request_id and user_agent to customer view. simplest is to expose aggregated series and drop labels: request_id, session_id. keep model and route_variant.

nina: +1. also recommend share tokens expire and be single-tenant-scoped. we should add an allowlist for outbound links.

ops-bot: retention policy reminder: detailed runtime logs retained 90 days, metrics 365 days. audit events stored in audit-log-svc.

miguel: technical note — Prometheus metrics we expose currently:
```
request_latency_seconds_bucket{job="runtime", tenant_id="<id>", model="gpt-4-like", route_variant="primary"}
request_tokens_total{job="runtime", tenant_id="<id>", model="..."}
cache_hits_total{job="runtime", tenant_id="<id>"}
fallback_count_total{job="runtime", tenant_id="<id>"}
```
We can add `token_cost_estimate` as a gauge.

jordan: for RBAC model proposal: roles = [viewer, team_analyst, org_admin, platform_admin]. Access rules:
- viewer: can see customer-facing dashboards scoped to their tenant only (no raw ids)
- team_analyst: internal aggregated + more labels, no cross-tenant
- org_admin: cross-tenant within org, full metrics
- platform_admin: global
Prefer attribute-based checks using claim `tenant_id` in JWT rather than brittle group lists.

maya: how do we represent field-level redaction in the dashboard config? need a simple way for product owners to flag fields.

kevin: propose dashboard config schema snippet (simple):
```
redaction:
  customer_view:
    drop_labels: ["request_id","session_id","user_agent"]
    aggregate_by: ["model","route_variant"]
    expose_percentiles: ["p50","p95"]
```
That can be validated by console and enforced server-side when serving customer share.

nina: logging/audit requirements: every view/share action should emit an audit event: {actor, action, dashboard_id, scope, share_to?, timestamp}. store immutable. Also record `redaction_profile` applied.

miguel: small dev note — to compute p95 per tenant we use: 
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket{job="runtime",tenant_id="$tenant"}[5m])) by (le))
```
This works but heavy cardinality if we add many labels. we should cap label set for customer views.

jordan: agree on label cap. platform should enforce a max cardinality policy per dashboard/export. also add a warning in console if cardinality > threshold.

sarah: outstanding items to ship:
1) runtime: emit `token_cost_estimate` gauge + ensure tenant label on existing metrics (miguel)
2) console: implement redaction schema + share token flow + expiry (jordan)
3) security: define audit events and retention + allowlist for shares (nina)
4) product: finalize fields/percentiles for customer view (maya)
Anyone wanna volunteer to draft a short RFC by EOD tomorrow? :clock1:

maya: I can draft RFC first pass today, include sample screenshots and redaction schema.

kevin: I can put together RBAC/ABAC spec and a sample enforcement middleware for console.

miguel: I'll add `token_cost_estimate` to metrics and a sample scrape config.

eng-bot: deploy queue updated — branch `metrics/tenant-cost` queued for staging, ETA 2h. :rocket:

sarah: perfect. once the RFC is up let's have a 30m sync with eng-runtime + eng-platform + security. thanks all :thumbsup:
